kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتغلغل (form IIq)
# نَتَغَلْغَلُ (nataḡalḡalu) /na.ta.ɣal.ɣa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَغَلْغَلَ (taḡalḡala)
# نَتَغَلْغَلَ (nataḡalḡala) /na.ta.ɣal.ɣa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَغَلْغَلَ (taḡalḡala)
# نَتَغَلْغَلْ (nataḡalḡal) /na.ta.ɣal.ɣal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَغَلْغَلَ (taḡalḡala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
